description: This file defines Flask routes for user-related actions in a web application, including login, signup, signout, profile viewing, and profile updating. It utilizes a UserManager controller and manages user sessions and rendering templates.

classes.name: Blueprint
classes.description: Flask Blueprint object used to define a collection of routes related to user actions.

classes.name: UserManager
classes.description: Controller class managing user operations such as login, signup, profile retrieval, and updates.

methods.name: home
methods.description: Handles the root route, sets a background variable, initializes user session, and renders the home page.

methods.name: signin
methods.description: Handles user login, validates credentials, manages session, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles new user registration, validates input, creates user, and provides feedback.

methods.name: signout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing session and redirects to home.

methods.name: show_user
methods.description: Displays user profile and books, fetching data via UserManager.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user profile information and redirects to profile page.
